title: Navigation Reduction: Flattened Route Hierarchy and Intent-driven Access for Console
creator: Lena Zhao
description: Reduce cognitive load in the Redwood Console by flattening the left-nav route hierarchy, exposing intent-driven entry points, and surfacing cost and rollout telemetry at the route level. This ticket captures the design proposal, prototype links, research snapshots, and the acceptance criteria for the first-phase rollout.
background: Current console nav has deep nesting, multiple low-use entry points, and inconsistent affordances between workspaces, projects, and rollout views. Engineering metrics show spikes in help center queries for 'where is X' and product telemetry shows longer path lengths to cost breakdowns and rollout controls.
goals: Decrease average clicks to common tasks (dashboards, rollouts, cost view) by 30%
Introduce intent-driven landing chips so users can go directly to Cost Analysis, Rollout Controls, or Model Routes
Make role-aware routes (dev, ops, finance) visually discoverable without duplicating navigation items
Keep backward-compatible routes for integrations and deep links
out_of_scope: Full rewrite of Console branding or themes
Backend permission model changes (handled in separate Private/RBAC epic)
research_findings: User interviews (n=12) surfaced confusion between 'Project' vs 'Workspace' — 8/12 attempted to find cost data under Project and failed
Support tickets related to rollouts are often filed because users miss the 'Rollouts' nested menu — average time-to-action ~ 65s
Heatmaps show consistent drop-off at the second level of left-nav for new users
proposed_solutions: Flatten left-nav to a single level with contextual chips beneath the selected primary route
Add an intent strip above workspace header with three primary intents: 'Inspect Cost', 'Manage Rollout', 'Open Dashboard'
Role-aware badges that adapt the left-nav labels for Finance/Eng/Ops personas without creating duplicate items
Inline route micro-previews: hovering a primary route reveals the most-relevant secondary actions (eg. cost breakdowns, canary toggle, recent evals)
Graceful migration: preserve existing routes and redirect deep links; show a one-time guided tip for power users
user_flows: Persona: Platform Engineer -> Intent: Manage Rollout -> Steps: left-nav primary 'Environments' -> intent strip 'Manage Rollout' -> rollout quick-toggles -> fullscreen rollout console
Persona: Finance Analyst -> Intent: Inspect Cost -> Steps: left-nav primary 'Billing & Cost' -> cost chips -> quick breakdown for model, region, timeframe
accessibility_considerations: Ensure intent strip is keyboard reachable and operable via aria attributes
Contrast checks for role badges and chips to meet AA standards
Maintain consistent tab order when micro-previews appear
acceptance_criteria: Prototype validated in 3 moderated sessions with positive discoverability improvement
Click-path telemetry shows at least 20% reduction for targeted tasks in the pilot orgs
No regressions in deep-link behavior; 100% of previously bookmarked routes still resolve
Design handoff completed with annotated Figma, token mapping, and CSS spec

risks: Users reliant on muscle memory might be temporarily slower; mitigation: one-time guided tip + verbal changelog
Hover micro-previews could add render cost on low-end machines; mitigation: progressive enhancement and server-side snapshots
Role-aware labeling may hide items for hybrid-role users; mitigation: allow quick toggle to view full set
